clips.title: The story
paras: In Loch Modan, Mountaineer Stormpike is arranging a shield from Furen Longbeard. The armorsmith works far south in Stormwind City, so Stormpike asks a traveler to carry his order there.

Mountaineer Stormpike wants a new shield, and he trusts only Furen Longbeard to forge it. The mountaineer is willing to pay well to place the commission in the smith’s hands, though Loch Modan and Stormwind City lie far apart.

Stormpike wonders why Furen works so far from Ironforge and the Great Forge, where many dwarves make their home. He suspects Stormwind’s humans pay the smith a king’s ransom. When the order reaches Furen at his anvil, the armorsmith takes pride in hearing from the prestigious Stormpike clan and eagerly prepares to forge the shield.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is a dwarven armorsmith whose work I admire greatly. His name is Furen Longbeard, and his skill is unmatched. I need a new shield, and I must have one of his!

The problem is... Furen is far to the south, in the dwarven district within Stormwind. In traveler lands! I can't imagine why he would live there, so far from Ironforge. The travelers must pay him a king's ransom to keep him there!
So, if you want to travel and don't mind making some money, then will you send Furen my request for a shield?

clips.title: Progress
paras: A letter from the dwarven lands? I wonder who would call from so far to the north...
Please, let me see the order.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, a request from one of the Stormpikes. That's a proud clan, full of quality dwarves. Rich ones, too.
Thank you, friend. I'll get to work on Mountaineer Stormpike's shield by the end of the day.
